---
title: "Dtype Mapping"
subtitle: "Python-native types aligned"
format:
  typst:
    include-in-header: landscape.typ
---

+----------------------+------------------------------------+-----------------------------------+------------------------------------+--------------------------------+------------------------+
| Python type (native) | NumPy 2.4.2                        | pandas 3.0.0                      | SQL / SQLite 3.51.2                | GDAL 3.12.2 / rasterio 1.5.0   | Example value          |
+======================+====================================+===================================+====================================+================================+========================+
| `bool`               | `np.bool_` (`dtype=bool`)          | `bool` (no missing)\              | `BOOLEAN`\                         | n/a                            | `True`                 |
|                      |                                    | `boolean` (nullable)              | (SQLite: `INTEGER` 0/1)            |                                |                        |
+----------------------+------------------------------------+-----------------------------------+------------------------------------+--------------------------------+------------------------+
| `int`                | `np.int_` (platform; usually       | `int64` (no missing)\             | `INTEGER`\                         | `Int16` / `UInt16` / `Int32` / | `42`                   |
|                      | `int64`)\                          | `Int64` (nullable)                | (SQLite `INTEGER` is signed        | `UInt32` / `Int64` / `UInt64`  |                        |
|                      | (or explicit                       |                                   | 64-bit)                            |                                |                        |
|                      | `np.int32`/`np.uint16`/etc.)       |                                   |                                    |                                |                        |
+----------------------+------------------------------------+-----------------------------------+------------------------------------+--------------------------------+------------------------+
| `float`              | `np.float64` (default)             | `float64` (`NaN` for missing)     | `REAL` / `DOUBLE`\                 | `Float32` / `Float64`          | `3.14`                 |
|                      |                                    |                                   | (SQLite `REAL` is 8-byte float)    |                                |                        |
+----------------------+------------------------------------+-----------------------------------+------------------------------------+--------------------------------+------------------------+
| `complex`            | `np.complex128` (default)          | `complex128`                      | n/a                                | `CFloat32` / `CFloat64`        | `1.5+2.5j`             |
+----------------------+------------------------------------+-----------------------------------+------------------------------------+--------------------------------+------------------------+
| `str`                | dtype `'<U…'` (fixed-width         | dtype: `str` (default)\           | `TEXT`                             | n/a                            | `'this is a string'`   |
|                      | unicode)\                          | (pyarrow-backed if installed)\    |                                    |                                |                        |
|                      | (`np.str_` scalar)                 | missing: `NaN`                    |                                    |                                |                        |
+----------------------+------------------------------------+-----------------------------------+------------------------------------+--------------------------------+------------------------+
| `bytes`              | dtype `'|S…'` (fixed-width bytes)\ | `object` (bytes)                  | `BLOB`                             | n/a                            | `b'\x01\x02'`          |
|                      | (`np.bytes_` scalar)               |                                   |                                    |                                |                        |
+----------------------+------------------------------------+-----------------------------------+------------------------------------+--------------------------------+------------------------+
| `None`               | `object` (stores `None`)\          | Missing value (dtype-dependent):\ | `NULL`                             | n/a                            | `None`                 |
|                      | (no numeric missing)               | `NaN` / `pd.NA` / `NaT`           |                                    |                                |                        |
+----------------------+------------------------------------+-----------------------------------+------------------------------------+--------------------------------+------------------------+
| `datetime.datetime`  | `datetime64[us]` (from stdlib      | `datetime64[us]` often inferred\  | `TIMESTAMP` / `DATETIME`\          | n/a                            | `datetime(2026, 2, 12, |
|                      | datetime)\                         | (pandas 3.0 infers unit)          | (SQLite storage:                   |                                | 15, 4, 5)`             |
|                      | (unit selectable)                  |                                   | `TEXT`/`REAL`/`INTEGER`)           |                                |                        |
+----------------------+------------------------------------+-----------------------------------+------------------------------------+--------------------------------+------------------------+
| `datetime.date`      | `datetime64[D]` (day unit)\        | `object` (date)\                  | `DATE`\                            | n/a                            | `date(2026, 2, 12)`    |
|                      | (or `datetime64[us]`)              | (use `to_datetime` →              | (SQLite: typically ISO8601 `TEXT`) |                                |                        |
|                      |                                    | `datetime64`)                     |                                    |                                |                        |
+----------------------+------------------------------------+-----------------------------------+------------------------------------+--------------------------------+------------------------+
| `datetime.timedelta` | `timedelta64[...]` (unit)          | `timedelta64[...]` / `Timedelta`\ | n/a                                | n/a                            | `timedelta(days=1,     |
|                      |                                    | (pandas 3.0 infers unit)          |                                    |                                | seconds=2)`            |
+----------------------+------------------------------------+-----------------------------------+------------------------------------+--------------------------------+------------------------+
| `decimal.Decimal`    | `object` (`decimal.Decimal`)       | `object` (`decimal.Decimal`)\     | `NUMERIC` / `DECIMAL`              | n/a                            | `Decimal('12.34')`     |
|                      |                                    | (Arrow decimal possible)          |                                    |                                |                        |
+----------------------+------------------------------------+-----------------------------------+------------------------------------+--------------------------------+------------------------+
| `dict` (JSON-like)   | `object` (dict)                    | `object` (dict)\                  | `TEXT` (JSON)\                     | n/a                            | `{'a': 1}`             |
|                      |                                    | (Arrow JSON possible)             | (JSON functions available)         |                                |                        |
+----------------------+------------------------------------+-----------------------------------+------------------------------------+--------------------------------+------------------------+
| notes                | • No intrinsic “nodata” dtype.\    | • v3.0 default string dtype is    | • SQLite uses type affinity        | • Raster band dtypes are       | —                      |
|                      | • `NaN` only for floats.\          | `str`.\                           | (dynamic typing).\                 | numeric only.\                 |                        |
|                      | • `object` dtype stores arbitrary  | • Datetime/timedelta unit         | • Datetime commonly ISO8601 `TEXT` | • Nodata/masks are metadata +  |                        |
|                      | Python objects (slow).             | inference (often `[us]`).         | or Unix epoch `INTEGER`.\          | mask band.\                    |                        |
|                      |                                    |                                   | • No `INTERVAL` type.              | • “Byte” is uint8 numeric;     |                        |
|                      |                                    |                                   |                                    | driver support varies.         |                        |
+----------------------+------------------------------------+-----------------------------------+------------------------------------+--------------------------------+------------------------+
